shortDescription: Build images for use by Podman Quadlets

options.name: annotation
options.description: Dictionary of key=value pairs to add to the image. Only works with OCI images. Ignored for Docker containers.

options.name: arch
options.description: CPU architecture for the container image

options.name: authfile
options.description: Path to file containing authorization credentials to the remote registry.

options.name: build_args
options.description: Dictionary of key=value pairs to add as build argument.

options.name: ca_cert_dir
options.description: Path to directory containing TLS certificates and keys to use.

options.name: cache
options.description: Whether or not to use cached layers when building an image

options.name: cmd_args
options.description: Extra global arguments to pass to the C(podman) command (e.g., C(--log-level=debug)). These are placed after the executable and before the subcommand.

options.name: dns
options.description: Set custom DNS servers in the /etc/resolv.conf file that will be shared between all containers in the pod. A special option, "none" is allowed which disables creation of /etc/resolv.conf for the pod.

options.name: dns_opt
options.description: Set custom DNS options in the /etc/resolv.conf file that will be shared between all containers in the pod.

options.name: dns_search
options.description: Set custom DNS search domains in the /etc/resolv.conf file that will be shared between all containers in the pod.

options.name: env
options.description: Dictionary of key=value pairs to add as environment variable.

options.name: executable
options.description: Path to C(podman) executable if it is not in the C($PATH) on the machine running C(podman).

options.name: file
options.description: Path to the Containerfile if it is not in the build context directory.

options.name: force_rm
options.description: Always remove intermediate containers after a build, even if the build is unsuccessful.

options.name: group_add
options.description: Add additional groups to run as

options.name: ignore_file
options.description: Path to an alternate .containerignore file to use when building the image.

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels to set on the image.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the image to build. It may contain a tag using the format C(image:tag).

options.name: network
options.description: List of the names of CNI networks the build should join during the RUN instructions.

options.name: password
options.description: Password to use when authenticating to remote registries.

options.name: pull
options.description: Pull image policy. The default is 'missing'.

options.name: quadlet_dir
options.description: Path to the directory to write quadlet file in. By default, it will be set as C(/etc/containers/systemd/) for root user, C(~/.config/containers/systemd/) for non-root users.

options.name: quadlet_file_mode
options.description: The permissions of the quadlet file. The O(quadlet_file_mode) can be specified as octal numbers or as a symbolic mode (for example, V(u+rwx) or V(u=rw,g=r,o=r)). For octal numbers format, you must either add a leading zero so that Ansible's YAML parser knows it is an octal number (like V(0644) or V(01777)) or quote it (like V('644') or V('1777')) so Ansible receives a string and can do its own conversion from string into number. options.name: quadlet_filename
options.description: Name of quadlet file to write. By default it takes image name without prefixes and tags.

options.name: quadlet_options
options.description: Options for the quadlet file. Provide missing in usual build args options as a list of lines to add.

options.name: retry
options.description: Number of times to retry pulling or pushing images between the registry and local storage in case of failure. Default is 3.

options.name: retry_delay
options.description: Duration of delay between retry attempts when pulling or pushing images between the registry and local storage in case of failure.

options.name: secret
options.description: Pass secret information used in Containerfile build stages in a safe way. Generally has the form C(secret[,opt=opt ...]). Can be specified multiple times.

options.name: set_working_directory
options.description: Provide context (a working directory) to podman build.

options.name: target
options.description: Specify the target build stage to build.

options.name: username
options.description: username to use when authenticating to remote registries.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Require HTTPS and validate certificates when pulling or pushing. Also used during build if a pull or push is necessary.

options.name: variant
options.description: Override the default architecture variant of the container image to be built.

options.name: volume
options.description: Specify multiple volume / mount options to mount one or more mounts to a container.
